events.title: Tajweed for Brothers at Masjid Al-Noor

events.title: MCA Summer Camp 2026
events.description: Join us for 9 weeks of fun, learning, and community! Our weekday camp is led by experienced teachers and youth mentors, offering a balanced mix of outdoor activities, Islamic learning, arts & crafts, and more.Flexible weekly sign-ups availableDiscounts for 4 weeks, 5 weeks, or all 9 weeksDaily snacks provided (parents pack lunch)From sports and storytelling to Surah learning and Dhuhr prayer, your child will enjoy a meaningful and engaging summer, inshaAllah.Children must be potty trained and able to use the bathroom independently. Age groups require a minimum number of participants; otherwise, ages 8+ may be combined.For financial aid inquiries: youth@mcabayarea.orgRegister HereWhen: Mon- Fri | June 8 – August 6 | 10 am - 3 pmWhere: MCA Youth Lounge

events.title: Nexus Summer Camp
events.description: Nexus Summer Camp is a 3-week Islamic summer experience for children ages 6–12, built around the theme "Beyond the Horizon: Character & Legacy" Through Quran, Seerah, sports, art, mentorship, and more, campers will grow in faith, character, and community.When: Mondays - Thursdays | July 20- Aug 6 | 10:30 AM-3:00 PMWhere: MCA Khadijah Banquet HallRegister Here

events.title: Health Heroes Kids’ Workshop
events.description: Children ages 7 to 12 are invited to a fun, interactive Health Heroes workshop where they will rotate through activity stations, solve health mysteries, and learn how to recognize common illnesses and respond safely. Activities will cover topics such as fever, dehydration, germs, injuries, breathing problems, medicine safety, and healthy habits.When: Thursday, August 6, 2026 | 3:30 PM to 5:30 PMWhere: MCA Maryam HallRSVP

events.title: Islam 101: A New Muslims’ Guide
events.description: A New Muslims’ GuideNew Muslims, as well as those interested in learning about Islam, are invited to join this weekly class. Don't forget to RSVPWhen: Every Thursday 6:30 PMWhere: MCA Youth Lounge

events.title: Level Up Deen: Youth Summer Program
events.description: Join us this summer for Level Up Deen: A Summer Faith & Nourishment Program with Sheikh Imran Vaid as we strengthen our connection with the Qur'an and grow in our understanding of Islam together!
